content.text: 获取字符串的字节长度。Gets the byte length of a string
字符串的UTF-8字节长度。The UTF-8 byte length of the string

优先使用TextEncoder，其次Buffer；当两者都不可用（极旧环境）时降级为value.length，返回的是UTF-16码元数而非UTF-8字节数。Prefers TextEncoder, then Buffer; when neither is available (very old environments) it falls back to value.length, which is the UTF-16 code-unit count rather than the UTF-8 byte length.

```ts
getStringByteLength('hello'); // -> 5
getStringByteLength('你好'); // -> 6（UTF-8 每个中文字符3字节）
```

text.comment: 要计算字节长度的字符串 / string to measure

Function:

getStringByteLength

Description:

获取字符串的字节长度。Gets the byte length of a string

Returns:

字符串的UTF-8字节长度。The UTF-8 byte length of the string

Remarks:

优先使用TextEncoder，其次Buffer；当两者都不可用（极旧环境）时降级为value.length，返回的是UTF-16码元数而非UTF-8字节数。Prefers TextEncoder, then Buffer; when neither is available (very old environments) it falls back to value.length, which is the UTF-16 code-unit count rather than the UTF-8 byte length.

Example:
getStringByteLength('hello'); // -> 5
getStringByteLength('你好'); // -> 6（UTF-8 每个中文字符3字节）
Example:
getStringByteLength(''); // -> 0
